title: Freelancer Workspace — guide
overview: A modular workspace for independent work. Opportunities is available; Finances and AI site creation are future modules.
usage: Sign in, select a circle on the right map or edit center coordinates and radius, apply the region, then search explicitly. Filter by category, contact status, and known channels. View company details or prepare an editable WhatsApp proposal. Enter an HTTPS portfolio URL before opening WhatsApp. Record actual contact separately.
eligibility: Only companies without a website URL listed by the source are eligible. This is not evidence that a business has no website. Google Nearby Search returns at most 20 ranked places per request; results are non-exhaustive. WhatsApp and Instagram are not inferred from phone numbers. Demo contacts are never opened.
architecture: The browser calls authenticated Next.js Experience routes. A process-api repository adapter forwards the verified session to the Fastify Process API. Domain usecases enforce eligibility; repository adapters isolate memory or Firestore persistence. Firebase SDKs are isolated inside infrastructure.
domains: Opportunity searches use a validated Region value object. Contact state transitions from not-contacted version 0 to contacted version 1. Firebase identity owns each contact record. Contact commands require an expected version and UUID idempotency key. The same command replays its result; conflicting payloads or versions return 409. External provider calls do not occur inside database transactions.
content: English and Brazilian Portuguese UI copy is stored in apps/docs/content/<locale>/workspace.json, accessed through GetContent and the CMS port. Theme tokens come from .stitch/DESIGN.md; separate components live in packages/design-system.
api: POST /api/opportunities/search → POST /v1/opportunities/search; GET /api/opportunities/:id → GET /v1/opportunities/:id; POST /api/contacts → POST /v1/contacts. JSON bodies are validated with Zod. /api/auth/session and /api/auth/logout establish or clear HttpOnly sessions with same-origin checks. GET /api/health is public and contains no user data. Process Swagger: http://localhost:3011/docs; contract: /docs/json.
configuration: infra.auth.provider: local (development) | firebase-auth (production). infra.repositories.provider: process-api for Next.js; memory (development) | firestore for API. infra.places.provider: demo | google-places. infra.maps.provider: schematic | google. infra.cms.provider: json. domains.opportunities.usecases.search/details/recordContact: default. domains.auth.usecases.session: default. domains.content.usecases.getContent: default. http.swagger.enabled: true. Secrets are environment references; unknown shift keys fail. APP_ENV selects config overrides.
setup: Target Firebase project freela-c8c75. Google sign-in selected; each user owns their history. The default Firestore Standard Native database is created in us-central1 (Iowa), provider-verified freeTier=true, with deny-all browser rules deployed. The user prioritized cheapest/free hosting; paid recovery features are disabled, and future API runtime is configured in the same region. Billing remains disabled. Cloud Auth, ADC, restricted Maps/Places credentials, App Hosting and CI setup remain pending; see deploy/SETUP.md.
privacy: Only place identifiers and user-entered contact state/history are persisted for live Google results; returned company details are not stored in Firestore. Do not put personal contact notes into logs. Local authentication and in-memory persistence refuse production startup. App Check and deployment access protection remain required before publishing.
validation: Run pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm coverage, pnpm test:e2e, pnpm test:stories, pnpm build and pnpm changelog. Local servers: web 3000, API 3011, docs 3002, Storybook 6006. No listeners are required: search is a bounded request, and WhatsApp opens only after a user action.
verification: Local validation passed: lint, typecheck, unit/component/API/contracts, four Playwright flows, 24 Storybook render/a11y checks, Firestore emulator rules/concurrency checks and all four builds. Overall line coverage is 99.62%; every changed runtime file meets the 90% gate. Per-app lcov and summary reports are generated. The compiled API health and Swagger routes were smoke-tested. Cloud deployment, live Google sign-in and live Places results remain unverified and blocked by setup prerequisites.
deployment: Source publication completed to https://github.com/bruno-bert/freela on November 16, 2026. Application source commit b56e63cab1942c536c2399b6937991a0e73c95a9 has a verified tree identical to the prepared local source, including all Stitch assets. Firebase billing remains disabled and Firebase Auth is not initialized. Google sign-in, restricted Maps/Places credentials and the production application deployment remain pending. See deploy/SETUP.md for evidence and prerequisites.
